metadata.title: Plan and Design Step
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Analyze requirements and design a new process step. Use before creating step files.

output.description: Complete step design including purpose, structure, and flow diagram

prerequisites: Clear understanding of what the step should accomplish
Knowledge of existing steps to avoid duplication
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: review requirements → check existing → determine category → write purpose → define use cases → plan structure → design flow → plan substeps
Emphasize simplicity: avoid over-engineering, keep designs focused
Use generic step references: reference 'previous step' not specific numbers
Steps only produce outputs: don't include flow control logic in steps

create: step-design.md (readable design document in process folder)
update: memory.json (current step section with design details)

tools: read_file - Read existing steps and README
grep - Search for similar patterns in existing steps
bestPractices: Check existing steps before creating new ones
Ensure flow diagram accurately represents substeps
Agents make individual tool calls sequentially
Consolidate related operations into single substeps
Prefer unified flows over multiple branches

substeps.name: Review requirements
substeps.description: Understand what the new step should accomplish
actions: Review the stated need for a new step
Identify the specific problem or task it solves
Document the expected behavior

substeps.name: Check existing steps
substeps.description: Verify no similar step already exists
actions: List existing steps in relevant categories
Search for similar functionality
Identify steps that could be extended vs creating new

substeps.name: Determine category
substeps.description: Select the appropriate category for the step
actions: Review categories: api, service, data, template, testing, planning, learning, investigation, common
Select category based on step purpose
Document rationale for category choice

substeps.name: Write purpose statement
substeps.description: Define clear purpose for the step
actions: Write one-sentence purpose statement
Describe what the step does (not how)
Ensure purpose is specific and measurable

substeps.name: Define use cases
substeps.description: Document when to use this step
actions: List scenarios where step applies
Define prerequisites or conditions
Identify which templates might use this step

substeps.name: Plan step structure
actions: Plan user documentation sections
Plan guidance content (specific actions, tools, files)
Define expected output and memory updates
Check .processes/steps/_components/ for applicable shared components (qa-session, mandatory-logging, etc.)

substeps.name: Design flow diagram
substeps.description: Create mermaid flowchart for the step
actions: Design logical flow of operations
Create mermaid flowchart syntax
Ensure flow covers all substeps

substeps.name: Plan substeps
actions: Break down step into logical substeps
Write clear descriptions for each
Define specific actions for each substep

substeps.name: Create step-design.md
substeps.description: Create a readable markdown document with the complete step design
actions: Create step-design.md in the process folder
Include: Overview, Purpose, Use Cases, Prerequisites, Output, Flow Diagram, Substeps, Decisions Made
This document is easier to review than memory.json
Update memory.json with reference to design document

flow.description: Linear flow through all 9 substeps: requirements → existing check → category → purpose → use cases → structure → flow → substeps → create design document

fields: Information Produced: Purpose statement, category, structure plan, flow diagram, substeps plan
Decisions Made: Category selection, design choices
